exposure: Parity status (nulliparous, single vaginal delivery, single cesarean delivery)
cohort: The study included 405 Turkish women aged 18 to 45 years who were either nulliparous or had experienced a single birth (vaginal or cesarean delivery).
finding: The mean GH value was 23.8 mm and the average PB length was 31.1 mm in Turkish women, with GH enlargement associated with single vaginal delivery, mediolateral episiotomy, age, and weight.
mod_finding: Genital hiatus (GH) values were significantly higher in women with a single vaginal delivery compared to nulliparous women and those who had a single cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at a single point in time in women categorized by their past obstetric history (nulliparous or single birth).
